turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What laptop specs actually matter for college?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: For most students, good battery life, at least eight gigs of memory and a comfortable keyboard. Raw speed matters less than people think.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm studying architecture, does that change things?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Yes, quite a bit. Design software needs sixteen gigs of memory or more and a decent graphics chip.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ugh, that sounds expensive. Is there

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Check if your school has computer labs with the software installed. Then a mid range laptop could be enough.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Good point. I'll ask at orientation.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Great idea. Ask older students too, they'll know what really works for the program.
